title: Obsidian Energy Announces $75 million Add-On to our Existing Senior Unsecured Notes
summary: NOT FOR DISTRIBUTION TO UNITED STATES NEWSWIRE SERVICES OR FOR DISSEMINATION IN THE UNITED STATES Obsidian Energy Announces $75 million Add-On to our Existing Senior Unsecured Notes Calgary, Alberta–(Newsfile Corp. – July 15, 2026) – OBSIDIAN ENERGY LTD. (TSX: OBE) (NYSE American: OBE) (“Obsidian Energy“, the “Company“, “we“, “us” or “our“) announces that we have entered into an underwriting agreement to sell, on a private placement basis (the “Offering“), an additional $75.0 million aggregate principal amount to our existing 8.125% senior unsecured notes due December 3, 2030, issued on December 3, 2025 (the “Notes“).
